title: Gnarled Night Rider
description: A surreal creature with a large ornate letter G for a head and a long scythe-like neck stands atop a massive, swirling wooden wave-like structure under a starry night sky. Several plump pink piglets cling to its twisted, vine-covered body while a gothic castle silhouette appears in the distant background below two glowing moons.
prompt: Surreal night scene featuring a bizarre creature with an ornate capital letter G as its head and a long scythe blade extending from its neck. The body is a twisted dark vine-like structure with several plump pink piglets clinging to it. The creature stands on a massive swirling wooden wave formation that frames the scene. Starry dark blue sky with two glowing moons and a distant gothic castle silhouette on the horizon, in an intricate detailed fantasy painting style.
